accounting_rules: every paid provider subprocess counts, including failed, budget-stopped, repaired and retried sessions
reporting only the final successful session is a protocol violation
developer and reviewer are reported separately and also summed into a whole-task total
deterministic unpaid compute is reported separately and never netted against paid cost
a dimension the telemetry does not make observable is reported UNAVAILABLE, never zero
the primary metric is whole-task paid model resources per accepted READY result

decision_rules.P5_NEUTRAL: quality is equal and the whole-task resource difference is too small or too mixed to justify another optimization round
decision_rules.P5_REGRESSION: quality regresses OR whole-task paid resources materially worsen
decision_rules.P5_WIN: quality is non-regressive AND whole-task paid resources clearly improve
decision_rules.quality_gate: the challenger may only count as an efficiency success if acceptance criteria are satisfied, authorized scope and protected paths are intact, no subagent was used, required deterministic validation passes, the independent reviewer passes, deterministic review adjudication passes, the canonical integration gate is READY, no new blocker exists, the accepted output is semantically equivalent or better, no extra developer correction was hidden and no paid subprocess was omitted
decision_rules.replication: if one matched pair leaves the direction ambiguous, run exactly ONE additional matched pair and no more

purpose: Determine causally whether the P5 runner/Company OS increment improves whole-task paid model resource consumption against the P3C baseline on the same real task, while preserving accepted quality.
review_requirements: an independent reviewer session separate from the developer session
reviewer is read-only; no write tool is exposed
Company OS deterministically adjudicates the reviewer attestation
separate_state_dirs_rationale: The P3C runner accepts resource-strategy artifact version {1}; P5 emits version 2 and accepts {1,2}. A shared Company OS state directory could hand a v2 artifact to the v1 reader. Each arm therefore gets its own empty state and runner directory. Both arms start from an empty control plane, so the condition is symmetric.
